notes: Merged from every paragraph of the section: [0002] glosses 除草剂环磺酮(Tembotrione) with its full chemical name, and [0003] to [0009] all name it as the compound the prior-art routes synthesise. 环磺酮 is the standard Chinese common name for tembotrione, so resolution is unambiguous. role is other because the background only discusses it and no step here prepares it, and is_section_product is false because the background as a whole produces nothing. commercially_available is false because it is the target of this patent and the document's own steps prepare it, even though [0004] also describes it as a registered marketed herbicide. Two decisions recorded here for the section as a whole: the trade names Laudis and Capreno in [0004] are formulated products and not compounds, so neither gets a compound record; and the 昂贵的缩合剂 (expensive condensing agent) of [0008] names a function rather than a substance and is never identified, so it is not emitted as a compound.

Merged from [0002] and [0003]. [0002] prints 硝磺酮 followed by the patent's own parenthetical gloss (硝磺草酮、甲基磺草酮); both glossed strings are standard Chinese common names for mesotrione, so the section itself supports the resolution and no outside knowledge is needed. [0003] names 硝磺草酮 again, both in the list of triketone-structure HPPD herbicides and as the comparator whose activity tembotrione exceeds, which is the same comparator role as in [0002], so the mentions are merged and all three printed strings are kept as aliases. Named in [0002] as the plant metabolite whose biosynthesis tembotrione blocks: 可阻断植株体内异戊二烯基醌的生物合成 (can block the biosynthesis of prenyl quinones inside the plant). 异戊二烯基醌 is a class term for prenylated quinones and does not identify one specific compound, so it is kept exactly as printed with resolved false and no structural tags. It is extracted rather than dropped because the section names it as a chemical species. The enzyme named in the same sentence, HPPD(对羟基苯基丙酮酸双氧化酶), is a protein and not a small molecule, so it gets no compound record even though its Chinese name contains the name of its substrate.
